import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static Map<Long, Long> memo = new HashMap<>();

    static long rec(long n) {
        if (memo.containsKey(n))
            return memo.get(n);
        if (n <= 11) {
            long res = Math.min(n, 2 + (11 - n));
            memo.put(n, res);
            return res;
        }
        long x = 1;
        int c = 1;
        while (n > x) {
            x = x * 10 + 1;
            c++;
        }
        if (x > n * 2) {
            long res = (n / (x / 10)) * (c - 1) + rec(n % (x / 10));
            memo.put(n, res);
            return res;
        }
        long res = Math.min(rec(x - n) + c, (n / (x / 10)) * (c - 1) + rec(n % (x / 10)));
        memo.put(n, res);
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long s = sc.nextLong();
        System.out.println(rec(s));
        sc.close();
    }
}
